title: Reproduction materials: from a panel of goodness-of-fit tests to one decision
description: Simulation code, stored per-data-set p-values of fourteen goodness-of-fit tests for logistic regression, and the analysis scripts that produce every table of the paper 'From a Panel of Goodness-of-Fit Tests to One Decision: Redundancy, the Limits of Learned Weights, and Robustness in Logistic Regression' and its supplementary material.
